<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<odoo noupdate="1">
    <!-- As explained on https://www.sussex.ac.uk/informatics/punctuation/capsandabbr/abbr
    British usage favours omitting the full stop in abbreviations which
    include the first and last letters of a single word,
    such as Mr, Mrs, Ms, Dr and St
    American usage prefers Mr., Mrs., Ms., Dr. and St., with full stops.
    -->
    <record id="res_partner_title_madam" model="res.partner.title">
        <field name="name">Madam</field>
        <field name="shortcut">Mrs.</field>
        <field name="sequence" eval="10" />
    </record>
    <!-- In English, there is no shortcut for "Miss"  -->
    <record id="res_partner_title_miss" model="res.partner.title">
        <field name="name">Miss</field>
        <field name="sequence" eval="20" />
    </record>
    <record id="res_partner_title_mister" model="res.partner.title">
        <field name="name">Mister</field>
        <field name="shortcut">Mr.</field>
        <field name="sequence" eval="30" />
    </record>
    <record id="res_partner_title_doctor" model="res.partner.title">
        <field name="name">Doctor</field>
        <field name="shortcut">Dr.</field>
        <field name="sequence" eval="40" />
    </record>
    <record id="res_partner_title_prof" model="res.partner.title">
        <field name="name">Professor</field>
        <field name="shortcut">Prof.</field>
        <field name="sequence" eval="50" />
    </record>
</odoo>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<!--
  Copyright 2025 Akretion France (https://www.akretion.com/)
  @author: Alexis de Lattre <alexis.delattre@akretion.com>
  License AGPL-3.0 or later (http://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl).
-->
<odoo>
    <record id="res_partner_title_form" model="ir.ui.view">
        <field name="model">res.partner.title</field>
        <field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form>
                <sheet>
                    <widget
                        name="web_ribbon"
                        title="Archived"
                        bg_color="bg-danger"
                        invisible="active"
                    />
                    <group name="main">
                        <field name="name" />
                        <field name="shortcut" />
                        <field name="active" invisible="1" />
                    </group>
                </sheet>
            </form>
        </field>
    </record>

    <record id="res_partner_title_list" model="ir.ui.view">
        <field name="model">res.partner.title</field>
        <field name="arch" type="xml">
            <list>
                <field name="sequence" widget="handle" />
                <field name="name" />
                <field name="shortcut" />
            </list>
        </field>
    </record>

    <record id="res_partner_title_search" model="ir.ui.view">
        <field name="model">res.partner.title</field>
        <field name="arch" type="xml">
            <search>
                <field
                    name="name"
                    string="Title or Shortcut"
                    filter_domain="['|', ('name', 'ilike', self), ('shortcut', 'ilike', self)]"
                />
                <separator />
                <filter
                    string="Archived"
                    name="inactive"
                    domain="[('active', '=', False)]"
                />
            </search>
        </field>
    </record>

    <record id="res_partner_title_action" model="ir.actions.act_window">
        <field name="name">Contact Titles</field>
        <field name="res_model">res.partner.title</field>
        <field name="view_mode">list,form</field>
    </record>

    <menuitem
        id="res_partner_title_parent_menu"
        parent="base.menu_custom"
        name="Contact Titles"
        sequence="500"
    />

    <menuitem
        id="res_partner_title_menu"
        action="res_partner_title_action"
        parent="res_partner_title_parent_menu"
        sequence="10"
    />
</odoo>
